# CharacterCreation

`creation`

The choices a new player makes before entering the world: a name, a gender, a hair style and a hair colour. Gender picks a fixed chibi body preset; attributes are not chosen (every character starts at the AttributeSystem base). The host validates every field and refuses with a keyed reason.

> Let each player be someone recognisable from the first minute, with a name nobody else can impersonate

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| name | json | Name rule: { minLength, maxLength, maxSeparators, separators, combining, scripts: { <group>: [[lo, hi]] }, reserved, confusables, confusableSequences, accentFold }; uniqueness is per server on the TR39-style skeleton |
| genders | json | { <gender>: { appearance } }; the appearance preset fixes body, head, eyes, skin and proportions. Label: creation.gender.<id> |
| hairStyles | json | { <hair id>: { gender, shape } }; mesh models/characters/hair/<id>.glb.raw, icon icons/hair/<id>.png.raw |
| hairColors | json | Curated hair colours as DefaultPalette indices |
| defaultCreation | json | The creation a player who skips the screen gets: { gender, hair, hairColor } |
| startingKit | json | Items given once at creation: [{ item, quantity, equip }]; a server rule may replace it |
| proportionPreset | string | Body proportion preset both gender presets use |
| headRatio | json | Allowed head-to-height ratio of a created rig: { min, max } |
| refusals | json | Refusal reasons; the catalog key is creation.refuse.<reason> |

## Actions

### create

Create a character on the host from a name, gender, hair style and hair colour

**Conditions:**
- The name is 3–16 letters from one script group with at most one inner space, hyphen or apostrophe
- The name is unique per server on its skeleton (case, accents and confusable look-alikes folded) and is not reserved
- The hair style belongs to the chosen gender and the colour is in the curated list
- Attributes start at the AttributeSystem base; the client sends no attribute values
- A refusal carries a keyed reason the client renders in its own locale
